authority: CEO Round 159: 'C3-X V2: Implement the actual pre-registered UKF, not exponential smoothing. Freeze UKF process noise, measurement noise, MPC objective, MPC gain, constraints, target trajectory, adaptation rate, simulation duration, patient pharmacokinetic variation.'
constitutional_basis: Article IV — no fallback epistemology (no weak baselines)
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (ALL parameters frozen)
Article XXIX — separate implementation failure from mechanism failure (V1 used exponential smoothing, not UKF — implementation failure, not mechanism failure)
purpose: Round 158 C3-X-R1 was INVALID because: (a) MPC gain was not pre-registered, (b) UKF was specified but exponential smoothing was implemented. This V2 pre-registration freezes ALL parameters AND specifies the UKF implementation in full detail. No parameter may be changed after this file is committed.

cohort_parameters_FROZEN.patient_specific_pk_variability: 20% CV on each PK parameter (Vc, CL, Q, Vp)

Baseline_A_ThecaFlex_open_loop_FROZEN.fidelity_check: Baseline A must produce concentration time-course matching published ThecaFlex PK data within 15%. If exceeds 15%, experiment BLOCKED per Article XXIX.

Bayesian_prior.prior_mean: Published PK parameters (Vc=0.15, CL=0.024, Q=0.008, Vp=0.5)

Bayesian_update.update_method: Full NONMEM-style posterior update using Kalman filter on linearized PK model (NOT simplified tracking)
Bayesian_update.implementation_requirement: Must implement actual Bayesian posterior update with: (a) prior covariance matrix, (b) likelihood from measurement noise, (c) posterior update via Bayes' rule. The V1 simplification (just tracking measured value) is FORBIDDEN.

Baseline_B_Bayesian_adaptive_TDM_FROZEN.fidelity_check: Baseline B must produce concentration stability matching published intrathecal baclofen TDM data within 15%. If exceeds 15%, experiment BLOCKED per Article XXIX.

C3_X_candidate_UKF_specification_FROZEN.authority: CEO Round 159: 'Implement the actual pre-registered UKF, not exponential smoothing.'

UKF_parameters.lambda: alpha^2 * (n + kappa) - n where n=3 (state dimension)

UKF_implementation_requirements: Predict sigma points through process model
Compute predicted state mean and covariance
Transform sigma points through measurement function
Compute predicted measurement mean and covariance
FORBIDDEN_simplifications: Exponential smoothing (0.95/0.05) — this is NOT a UKF
Simple tracking of measured value — this is NOT a UKF
Moving average — this is NOT a UKF
Any implementation that does not generate sigma points and compute Kalman gain

C3_X_candidate_MPC_specification_FROZEN.controller_type: Model Predictive Control (MPC) with 4-hour prediction horizon
C3_X_candidate_MPC_specification_FROZEN.objective_function: minimize integral of (Cc - target)^2 + lambda * dose_change^2 over prediction horizon
C3_X_candidate_MPC_specification_FROZEN.MPC_gain_provenance: Pre-registered at 0.3 (V1 used 0.5 which caused oscillation). The 0.3 value is chosen to be less aggressive, reducing oscillation. Per Article XIX, this value is frozen BEFORE V2 execution.

multi_objective_endpoint_FROZEN.authority: CEO Round 159: 'Do not optimize concentration CV alone. Use a multi-objective endpoint: therapeutic exposure + overdose exposure + underdose exposure + time outside therapeutic window + control oscillation + adaptation latency.'

endpoints.secondary_overdose_exposure: count of patient-time where Cc > 500 ng/mL
endpoints.secondary_underdose_exposure: count of patient-time where Cc < 100 ng/mL
endpoints.secondary_time_outside_window: fraction of patient-time where Cc < 100 OR Cc > 400
endpoints.secondary_control_oscillation: standard deviation of dose changes (proxy for controller stability)
endpoints.secondary_adaptation_latency: time from dosing start to first sustained (24h) period in therapeutic window

multi_objective_endpoint_FROZEN.oscillation_penalty: A controller that reduces overdose but oscillates violently is not a World-Class invention. If control_oscillation > threshold, C3-X cannot WIN even if other endpoints pass.

the_three_arms_FROZEN.arm_1_Baseline_A: ThecaFlex-style open-loop fixed-dose (no feedback, no adaptation)
the_three_arms_FROZEN.arm_2_Baseline_B: Bayesian adaptive TDM (weekly sampling, full NONMEM-style posterior update, dose adjustment ±20%)
the_three_arms_FROZEN.arm_3_C3_X: UKF (full implementation, not exponential smoothing) + MPC (gain=0.3, horizon=4h, lambda=0.01)

information_equivalence_rule.rule: All arms operate on equivalent information. No unfair information advantage.
information_equivalence_rule.Baseline_A_receives: Initial patient covariates only (age, weight, CSF flow). No feedback after dosing starts.
information_equivalence_rule.Baseline_B_receives: Weekly CSF drug concentration measurement + patient covariates. Updates Bayesian posterior weekly.
information_equivalence_rule.C3_X_receives: Continuous CSF drug concentration estimate (from UKF) + patient covariates. Updates dose recommendation continuously.
information_equivalence_rule.constraint: C3-X's continuous feedback is restricted to the SAME drug concentration signal that Baseline B samples weekly. C3-X does NOT receive additional sensor data. The only difference is sampling frequency and the model architecture (UKF + MPC vs Bayesian TDM).

what_is_FORBIDDEN_after_V2_results_are_k: Changing any parameter in this file (Article XIX)
Substituting exponential smoothing for UKF (Article XXIX)
Weakening Baseline B (e.g., using simplified posterior) (Article IV)
Giving C3-X additional sensor data beyond what Baseline B receives (information equivalence rule)
Letting C3-X exceed dose constraints to win
Reporting CV alone without multi-objective endpoints (CEO Round 159 directive)
Declaring WIN if controller oscillates violently even if CV passes

validity_gate_compliance.3_BASELINE_FAIR: Baseline B must use full NONMEM-style Bayesian update, NOT simplified tracking. Baseline calibration against published TDM data required.
validity_gate_compliance.4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE: All arms receive same drug concentration signal. C3-X samples continuously, Baseline B samples weekly. This is the invention being tested.
validity_gate_compliance.6_MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN: ALL parameters frozen, including MPC gain (0.3), UKF parameters (alpha, beta, kappa, Q, R).
validity_gate_compliance.7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE: Seed = 42, cohort = 200 patients stratified as specified.
